flagged.evidence: The proof says “the connected covers classified by these kernels are isomorphic as covers.” The cited dependency `thm-classification-of-connected-covering-spaces` classifies coverings of a single base B (“...a bijection from ... coverings of B ... to subgroups of G”). Here the covers are over E and X_K, respectively, so that result alone does not give an isomorphism as covers. The inclusion E→X_K is a homotopy equivalence; lifting it gives a deck-equivariant homotopy equivalence of the cyclic covers, which suffices for the asserted H₁-module isomorphism.
